# Tests and evidence

- Follow the test framework and conventions already used in the repository.
- Name or document tests with the `US-NNN` / `REQ-NNN` they verify when the task has one (remote mode); in local mode follow the team's naming and keep the mapping in the task file.
- Cover the acceptance criteria, boundaries, error paths and a regression case for fixed bugs.
- Record exact commands and results in the task. A skipped, missing or zero-test run is never a pass.
- Do not weaken, delete or skip existing tests to make a check pass; that is a HAG-06 waiver.
